task.description: WF-02, step 1 — CODE-DESIGNER writes the code design of REQ-111 (R1.2, the public landing of Sai: landing, how it works, examples, demo survey and 404 in the approved v3 look, texts ru/kk/en, themes, the test-mode line and the AI disclosure, the one-tap demo on Sai's own intake through a byte copy of the picker engine that stores nothing, the forbidden-words lint, and the production build that leaves out the order texts and kk) and REQ-112 (R1.3, the office renderer in stage mode: the ports of the owner's office grid and movement with a parity test, the v3 drawing, the stage scene with four desks, the door and «Вы» moving only on the visitor's taps) in app/, task M1.4 of the program PUBLIC-V1, milestone M1 «Public URL» (releases R1.2 and R1.3), in docs/design/REQ-111-112-public-landing.md, by the section «Step 1» of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md and the interface lane of docs/workflows/WF-04-ui-by-sample.md (the look description docs/design/V1-public-look.md is the measure). Decision decisions/0123 answers the open questions of both blocks and binds the design wherever it differs from the blocks' text (a micro-amendment run writes its readings into the blocks later); the low findings J1, J6 and V4 of the look are named by this design. The model of form and strictness is docs/design/REQ-108-109-app-skeleton.md; app/ as it stands in the tree (main 0d8fa78) is what the design extends. A fix round outside this tree makes the closed branch of app/scripts/vercel-build.js safe to run twice in one build; the public-set split of decisions/0123 О3 is designed on top of it and is idempotent the same way. The design names: the files and modules with their interfaces (pure modules without DOM, clock or Math.random, 0123 О13); the data (the intake app/content/sai-intake.json of format /2, the texts module ru/kk/en, the public set of the build); every failure path (the demo API failing or silent, a storage that throws, the canvas failing, no script); the CSP rule (no inline script or style, no innerHTML, textContent only); the forbidden-words lint; the G8 «б» / G9 split as a testable rule of the build; the vendored engine with its sha256 in app/vendored.json and its tsc rule; the e2e job of app.yml with playwright-core; the table «criterion → test» for every criterion of both blocks (file, what it checks, its damaged copies or mutants, the red-without-fix plan); the guard tests of earlier requirements that change, with «was → became» rows; the test catalogue with counts; the build plan in small sub-steps for FRONTEND-DEV and BACKEND-DEV with the check after each; the quality bar section Q1–Q14, R1–R3; the open questions only ORCH can answer, each with a default (ORCH answers them in a decision record, WF-02 step 1a, before gate 1b). The risky parts are tried on a sketch outside the project (the public set built twice, the port parity of grid.js and sim.js against the originals, the lint over the planned texts, a page under the CSP in a headless Chrome), each trial recorded with its command and output so that the gate can repeat it on a clean copy; every value is marked measured, required by a record or proposed. The owner's words: «пуш, брат. Я хочу чтобы ты меня понял в корне и дал мне результат. Исходя нашей переписки и в целом»; «Да, сайт по ссылке (Recommended)» with the option text «… собираю первый выпуск сайта Sai по плану (страница «закрытое тестирование», потом главная с пиксельным офисом и демо-опросом) и выкладываю на Vercel … Без регистрации, заказов и данных …»; the approved mockup matched one to one, no blended redesign. Rules: never commit, push, tag, stash, reset or switch branches; write only the design and this handoff; trials only in a fresh clone outside the project; no path of the computer in a Sai file. Before close: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check && npm run traces.
